description: Dallas County precinct number: this extract's row key, one row per code. A row arrives by one of two routes -- either the unnamed first column of a sheet in the three district canvassing workbooks, or, for precincts no workbook named, a `dallas_county_precinct_id` in the VTD crosswalk. Join key to the VTD mapping and, with the county, to the precinct results roll-up; compared as TEXT, so codes like 0024 and 30C4 survive.
Name of the .ods sheet the row came from; a precinct group is the set of precincts one district worksheet covers (e.g. 'Casa View', 'Far Westside') (blank for 735 of 820 rows).
Dallas City Council district, taken from the source workbook filename (District 1 / District 2 / District 9) (blank for 735 of 820 rows).

Audit flag for the alignment repair. 'aligned' means the row's cells sat under their own headers; 'shifted_left_1_corrected' means the metric values were keyed one column left of their headers in the source and have been shifted right. 22 District 2 rows were corrected (blank for 735 of 820 rows).

Census voting-district identifier from the county precinct-to-VTD crosswalk. A precinct does map to several VTDs in that file, but the fan-out is collapsed before writing: this extract holds one row per precinct, so this column names the single VTD whose DFS figures were kept, not every VTD the precinct touches.
Share of this census VTD that falls inside the precinct (fraction 0-1).
Share of the county precinct covered by this census VTD (fraction 0-1); sums to 1 across a precinct's VTDs except precinct 1057, which is recorded in two districts.
Full Census GEOID of the voting district named by census_vtd_id; join key to the demographic export's `source_ref`.
The seat's id on the site: body:jurisdiction:source_ref. The join key to every related file.

Census voting-district identifier of the VTD this row's demographic figures describe -- the export's own seat name, which is a VTD code (`source_ref` == '48113' + `name`), NOT a Dallas County precinct number. The two namespaces are both four digits and coincide for some precincts while describing different ground, so this column is never a join key here: precincts are attributed through the VTD crosswalk only.
The kind of seat: county, county_subdivision (a town), municipality (a place), ward, council_district, school_district, precinct, us_house, state_senate, state_house, .
USPS state code.

The seat's code at its source, usually a Census GEOID (a 11-character GEOID20 for a precinct). Reached by this row's `census_vtd_geoid` from the precinct-to-VTD crosswalk: the export is keyed by VTD, and the VTD kept for a precinct is the one `dedupe_output_by_precinct()` scored fullest, tie-broken by the largest `share_of_county_precinct`. So these figures describe that VTD -- usually the one covering most of the precinct, but not guaranteed to be it.
